<?php

namespace CloudSDK\Infrastructure;

class ConnectionPool
{
    private array $connections = [];
    private int $maxSize;
    private array $metadata = [];

    public function __construct(int $maxSize = 10)
    {
        $this->maxSize = $maxSize;
    }

    public function acquire(string $region): Connection
    {
        $key = $this->normalizeRegion($region);
        if (!isset($this->connections[$key])) {
            $this->connections[$key] = new Connection($key);
        }
        return $this->connections[$key];
    }

    private function normalizeRegion(string $region): string
    {
        return preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9\-]/', '', strtolower($region));
    }

    public function setMetadata(string $key, string $value): void
    {
        $this->metadata[$key] = $value;
    }

    public function getMetadata(string $key): ?string
    {
        return $this->metadata[$key] ?? null;
    }
}

class Connection
{
    private string $region;
    private string $endpoint;

    public function __construct(string $region)
    {
        $this->region = $region;
        $this->endpoint = "https://api.{$region}.cloudprovider.internal";
    }

    public function getRegion(): string
    {
        return $this->region;
    }

    public function getEndpoint(): string
    {
        return $this->endpoint;
    }
}

class DiagnosticsRunner
{
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private array $trustedProbes = [
        'latency' => 'probe-latency',
        'throughput' => 'probe-throughput',
        'connectivity' => 'probe-connectivity',
    ];

    public function __construct(ConnectionPool $pool)
    {
        $this->pool = $pool;
    }

    public function registerProbe(string $name, string $binary): void
    {
        if ($this->validateProbeName($binary)) {
            $this->trustedProbes[$name] = $binary;
        }
    }

    private function validateProbeName(string $binary): bool
    {
        return (bool) preg_match('/^[a-z][a-z0-9\-]{0,30}$/', $binary);
    }

    public function runDiagnostics(string $probeType, string $target): array
    {
        $conn = $this->pool->acquire($target);
        $endpoint = $conn->getEndpoint();

        if (!isset($this->trustedProbes[$probeType])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Unknown probe type: {$probeType}");
        }

        $binary = $this->trustedProbes[$probeType];
        $result = $this->executeProbe($binary, $endpoint);
        return $result;
    }

    private function executeProbe(string $binary, string $endpoint): array
    {
        $label = $this->pool->getMetadata('diagnostics_label') ?? 'default';
        $cmd = sprintf(
            '/opt/cloudsdk/probes/%s --endpoint %s --label %s 2>&1',
            $binary,
            escapeshellarg($endpoint),
            escapeshellarg($label)
        );
        $output = shell_exec($cmd);
        return [
            'output' => $output,
            'timestamp' => time(),
            'probe' => $binary,
        ];
    }
}

class CloudInfrastructureClient
{
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private DiagnosticsRunner $diagnostics;

    public function __construct(array $config = [])
    {
        $this->pool = new ConnectionPool($config['pool_size'] ?? 10);
        $this->diagnostics = new DiagnosticsRunner($this->pool);

        if (isset($config['diagnostics_label'])) {
            $this->pool->setMetadata('diagnostics_label', $config['diagnostics_label']);
        }
    }

    public function connect(string $region): Connection
    {
        return $this->pool->acquire($region);
    }

    public function diagnose(string $probeType, string $region): array
    {
        return $this->diagnostics->runDiagnostics($probeType, $region);
    }

    public function updateLabel(string $label): void
    {
        $this->pool->setMetadata('diagnostics_label', $label);
    }
}

// Usage example - REST API handler
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    $client = new CloudInfrastructureClient([
        'pool_size' => 5,
        'diagnostics_label' => $_GET['label'] ?? 'production',
    ]);

    if (isset($_GET['action']) && $_GET['action'] === 'diagnose') {
        $region = $_GET['region'] ?? 'us-east-1';
        $probe = $_GET['probe'] ?? 'latency';
        $result = $client->diagnose($probe, $region);
        echo json_encode($result);
    }
}
